stem:
A relationship between x and y is shown on the graph.

Complete the equation that best describes the relationship between x and y.

Choose the correct answer from each drop-down menu to complete the equation.

y = [blank_1]x + [blank_2]
instruction: Choose the correct answer from each drop-down menu to complete the equation.
visual_elements: graph with line passing through (-2, -5) and (0, 1) on the xy-plane
notes: Two drop-down selections correspond to slope and y-intercept of the line shown on the graph.
